theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_smp_cutoff_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (F f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t C : ℝ) (g : ℝ → Euclid P → ℝ), Integrable F μ → Measurable f → (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 → AEStronglyMeasurable (g h) μ) → (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 → ∀ x, |g h x| ≤ C) → (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 → ∀ x, f x ≤ t - h → g h x = 1) → (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 → ∀ x, t ≤ f x → g h x = 0) → Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => ∫ x, g h x * F x ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ x in {x | f x < t}, F x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
